name: 💖Slayerbound💖
desc:
🔥 SLAYERBOUND – Demon Slayer Anime RPG on Roblox ⚔️

Slayerbound is an anime RPG inspired by Demon Slayer (Kimetsu no Yaiba) on Roblox. Become a powerful Demon Slayer, master breathing techniques, and fight dangerous demons in an immersive RPG experience.

⚔️ Become a Demon Slayer
Train your character
Unlock Breathing Styles
Use swords and special anime abilities

KEYBINDS 
M1 - Attack
M2 - Heavy Attack
F - Block
W+W - Run
M - Menu
G - Breathing
C - Impulse
J - Crow
1-9 - Skills


📈 Full RPG Progression
Level up your character
Upgrade stats
Unlock new skills
Grow stronger with every battle

🌍 Anime World Inspired by Demon Slayer
Detailed maps
Dark fantasy atmosphere
Designed for anime and RPG fans
